title: Head geometry is a memory decision
purpose: Count parameters, arithmetic and future KV payload without inventing speedups.
contract: Analytical counting convention: two FLOPs per multiply/add; no bias or output projection.
Illustrative KV storage is F16; it is not an implemented cache or measured traffic.
